title: Crystal Macro Mod
description: Automatically places and breakes Crystals for you, with adjustable settings. NOTE: THIS MOD IS NOT MEANT TO BE USED FOR BREAKING ANY SERVER RULES
body:
**Crystal Macro Mod – Advanced Crystal PvP Automation**

Crystal Macro Mod is a lightweight, high-performance crystal PvP utility designed for competitive PvP servers and practice environments. It provides precise control over end crystal placement and destruction while maintaining full stability during intense combat sessions.

Built for Fabric, this mod runs smoothly without causing lag, crashes, or desynchronization — even during extended PvP encounters.

⚠️ This mod uses doAttack/doItemUse simulation for seamless integration with Minecraft's native input system.

📌 Note: This mod is intended for use in environments where macros and automation tools are permitted. It is not designed or intended for breaking server rules, bypassing anti-cheat systems, or gaining an unfair advantage on servers that prohibit such tools. Always check and respect the rules of the server you are playing on. The developer assumes no responsibility for misuse.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ Features
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎮 Crystal Macro
- Automatically places and breaks end crystals
- Targets obsidian and bedrock surfaces for placement
- Randomized attack and place delays for natural behavior
- Pause after nearby player kill to avoid suspicion
- Hold right-click to activate — release to stop

⚔️ Break Only Mode
- Separate module from Crystal Macro
- Automatically breaks any end crystal you look at
- You place crystals manually — mod only handles destruction
- Independent toggle — does not require Crystal Macro to be active
- Adjustable break delay

🖥️ Clean GUI
- Scrollable settings menu with modern dark theme
- Purple accent design with smooth animations
- Section dividers for organized layout
- Keybind rebinding directly from the GUI
- Compact HUD overlay showing macro status

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⌨️ Hotkeys & Controls
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

J — Toggle Crystal Macro on/off
K — Open/close settings menu

⚠️ Keybinds are fully rebindable from the settings menu. Make sure they do not conflict with other mods or Minecraft controls.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🛠️ How to Use
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Launch Minecraft with Fabric.
2. Ensure there are no keybind conflicts.
3. Press K in-game to open the settings menu.
4. Enable Crystal Macro or Break Only Mode.
5. Configure delays and pause settings to your preference.
6. Hold end crystals in your main hand or offhand.
7. Hold right-click while looking at obsidian or bedrock — the macro handles the rest.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚙️ Settings Overview
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Crystal Macro
- Crystal Macro — Enable/disable the full place and break cycle
- Stop on Kill — Pause the macro when a nearby player dies
- Pause After Kill — Duration to pause after a kill (0–5000ms)
- Attack Delay Min — Minimum ticks between crystal attacks (0–10)
- Attack Delay Max — Maximum ticks between crystal attacks (0–10)
- Place Delay — Ticks between crystal placements (0–10)

Break Only Mode
- Break Only Mode — Enable/disable automatic crystal breaking
- Break Delay — Ticks between breaks (0–10)

Settings
- Show HUD — Toggle the compact status overlay
- Toggle Key — Rebind the macro toggle key
- GUI Key — Rebind the settings menu key

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📦 Requirements
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

- Minecraft (Fabric)
- Fabric Loader
- No Fabric API required — fully standalone

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📋 Defaults
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

- Pause After Kill — 1000ms
- Attack Delay Min — 1 tick
- Attack Delay Max — 1 tick
- Place Delay — 0 ticks
- Break Delay — 1 tick

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
